guidelines.detail: refines PROC-05 (The validator flags StartEvent_OrderSubmitted as a separate start-to-end chain, although S5 describes the stage as following the completed product selection with no new trigger, so the start event is an extra element that breaks the main flow. PROC-05 covers triggers that occur after the main flow and says to join them by a gateway, but it does not cover the case where no trigger is stated, which )

refines EVT-03 (The reference models the wait for the external confirmation as a task, and the generator instead modeled the handover as an extra send task, so the wait event and its flow into the join were missing (M1, X9, F1). The description says the customer has to wait until the external party confirms, which is a waiting condition, so an intermediate catch event is correct. EVT-03 already covers catch event)

same as LRN-120 (The reference models the customer's wait for the bank's payment confirmation as a wait element on the payment branch. The generated model instead has a send task (X9) that carries the payment data and has no wait element before the join gateway (M1). The description states the participant must wait for the confirmation (S6), and that other steps, the shipping address, continue during the wait (S7))

same as LRN-036 (The reference models the confirmation wait as a task that flows into the closing join, while the generated model uses a catch event with no flow into the join and has the join before Enter payment data bypassed (M1, F1, G14, G17, M5, F16). The generator's catch event is the correct BPMN choice for a wait on a bank confirmation, so the real gap is that the branch containing the wait was not closed )

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one stage begins right after a completed sequence of steps, and it names no new event, message, time or condition that starts that stage: Do not model a start event for that stage. Connect the last element of the preceding sequence to the first element of the stage with a sequence flow in the same process, so that the stage stays on the main flow. Use a parallel split gateway only if the description states that two or more following activities run simultaneously.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one stage begins right after a completed sequence of steps, and it names no new event, message, time or condition that starts that stage

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a participant has to wait until an external party confirms something it has already provided, and that wait happens on one branch of a parallel split whose other branches continue meanwhile: Model the wait for the external confirmation as an intermediate catch event on that branch, placed after the task in which the participant provides the information. Do not add a separate send task for the handover unless the description names sending as its own action. Join the branch with the other parallel branches at a parallel gateway, with a sequence flow from the wait event into that join gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a participant has to wait until an external party confirms something it has already provided, and that wait happens on one branch of a parallel split whose other branches continue meanwhile

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities run at the same time (joined by 'while' or 'and', or stated as simultaneous), and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model the concurrent activities as separate branches that start at one parallel gateway, with each activity in its own branch and placed in the lane of the participant who performs it. Close all branches with one matching parallel gateway placed before the later step. Do not sequence the concurrent activities one after another, do not omit an activity or merge it into another, and do not use an exclusive gateway, because it would choose one path while the description requires all of them to proceed.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that after a step, one branch contains a wait for an external confirmation (for example a bank or other party confirming something) while another activity in parallel with it is still running, and a later step starts only after both are finished

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all follow the same preceding event and are performed together, and a later step continues only after all of them are done: Model an opening parallel gateway after the preceding step, with one branch per listed activity, and close those branches with a joining parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway to join them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that, after a step, several activities are performed simultaneously and the process continues only after all of them are finished
